# API-PV-RENAME — pv rename <oldId> <newId>

- **Type:** api
- **Domain:** PV
- **Tags:** `pv`, `cli`, `graph`, `prd`
- **Created:** 2026-05-03T00:00:00.000Z

## Description

Atomically rename an Intent node id everywhere it appears: the node itself in graph.json, every incoming relation target across other nodes, the codemap entry, the collision flag and (if applicable) numeric counter in counters.json, and any frontmatter/section-directive/body mention across discovered PRDs (docs/prd/, prd/, prds/, or .polaris/prd-sources.json). Refuses cross-type renames (REQ→API) since type encodes the conceptual category. Supports --dry-run for verification. Solves the open question raised in PRD-PV-CORE around Intent rename UX.
